Requirement: Compares similarities and differences between visual stimuli (letters numbers objects patterns) quickly and accurately. Inputs: [U.Early-Visual-Features] [U.High-Level-Visual-Representation] [U.Top-Down-Attention-Control]. Output: [U.Decision-Output]. Handles diverse stimuli simultaneous/sequential presentation speed-accuracy balance.

Receives basic visual features and category representations adjusts via attention control generates decision output. Consistent with requirement.
Capability: Converts diverse visual stimuli to unified representation space computes similarity makes binary judgment via threshold. Category-independent. Based on relational coding and drift-diffusion model. Adapts to diverse task demands via dynamic adjustment. References: Liu et al. 2025.
Mechanism: Hierarchical processing (V1/V2 → Fusiform → posterior IPS → LIP → anterior IPS). Parallel processing (current stimuli and memory stimuli). Feedback control (top-down attention).

Requirement: Performs similarity evaluation and decision formation. Inputs: [U.Visual-Input-Integration] [U.Working-Memory-Maintenance] [U.Motion-Processing] [U.Thalamic-Attention-Hub] [U.Top-Down-Attention-Control]. Outputs: [U.Decision-Output] [U.Oculomotor-Control] [U.High-Level-Visual-Representation]. Computes similarity and forms binary decision.

Compares integrated and memory representations forms decision generates multiple outputs. Consistent.
Capability: Computes similarity distance between high-dimensional visual representations accumulates evidence makes binary decision via threshold judgment. Integrates relational coding drift-diffusion model top-down feedback. Controls speed-accuracy tradeoff via dynamic decision boundary adjustment. References: Nature Communications 2025 Greenberg et al. 2012 Basti et al. 2022.

Outputs (decision → dlPFC oculomotor → FEF visual adjustment → Fusiform Gyrus).
